identity.title: Build a bounded production-backed governance regression corpus

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Collect only already-observed or newly reproduced production-backed governance comparison cases into a small regression corpus covering the transition states that real evidence supports. Each case must preserve baseline/current evidence refs and a pre-declared human expected judgment. Missing transition classes remain unproven rather than synthesized.
human_pressure.why_now: The regression engine becomes trustworthy through a corpus of real judged cases, not through more ranking logic.
do_not_misread: Do not manufacture one sample for every enum value.
Coverage gaps are a valid result.
red_lines: No expectation rewriting after comparator output.
No new regression dimension or score.

machine_core.goal: Turn the real governance regression proof into a repeatable, bounded corpus of evidence-backed comparison cases.
red_lines: Do not change comparator ranking unless a corpus case first proves it wrong.
Do not commit raw sensitive runtime history.
invariants: Every corpus case names baseline and current evidence provenance.
Human expected judgment is fixed before asserting comparator output.
Absent real cases stay explicitly uncovered.

producer.artifact: real or production-derived baseline/current governance evidence pairs

consumer.component: governance regression comparator tests and dogfood review

observable_effect.assertion: Comparator behavior is exercised against a small set of human-reviewed real cases with explicit provenance and coverage gaps.

proofs.assertion: Corpus-driven regression tests and full suite pass; expectations are evidence-backed.

failure_semantics: Comparator disagreement with a pre-declared expected judgment is recorded as a real regression-policy finding.
Missing real cases do not justify synthetic coverage.

steps.title: Inventory real comparable pairs
details: Use 8067/8072 results and any additional production-derived pairs created by completed packs; reject pairs without a defensible comparison context.

steps.title: Record pre-declared expectations
details: For each supported dimension record baseline fact, current fact, expected transition and evidence refs before asserting code output.

steps.title: Run corpus tests
details: Compare projections with current source-neutral comparator; retain UNKNOWN/INCOMPARABLE where required.

steps.title: Report coverage gaps
details: List enum transitions/dimensions for which no real case exists without creating synthetic substitutes.

acceptance: Corpus contains only evidence-backed comparable pairs.
Every expectation has provenance and is fixed before assertion.
Comparator matches accepted human judgments or disagreement is explicitly reported and pack remains todo until resolved.

must_check: Every corpus case has real/production-derived provenance.
Comparison context is defensible and not based on producer identity.
Expected transitions were not reverse-engineered from implementation output.
reject_if: Expectations are changed after failures merely to obtain green tests.
Raw sensitive runtime history is committed.
